$comment: Every desktop and window manager the configurator offers. The generator writes `module.config` into the host's configuration.nix, so adding one is a data change. Special values: {"$path": "./x"} is a path in the host flake, {"$context": "users"} the users' names, {"$context": "configDir"} where the host flake lives. `checks.desktops` verifies every nixpkgs option path here exists. `unavailable` marks one that can't be installed with this nixpkgs (it doesn't evaluate or build; nix/screenshots finds out) and says why: it's shown but can't be picked.
